causes.name: Air / Supply Issue
causes.description: Trapped air or inconsistent air pressure in the material supply path causes erratic dispensing. Air bubbles disrupt fluid flow and create volume variation.

causes.name: Nozzle Restriction
causes.description: Partial or complete blockage of the dispensing nozzle reduces or blocks material flow. Can be caused by dried material, contamination, or mechanical damage.

causes.name: Material Condition
causes.description: Material properties (viscosity, shelf life, homogeneity, temperature sensitivity) are outside acceptable range, causing unpredictable dispensing behaviour.

causes.name: Pressure Instability
causes.description: Inconsistent dispensing pressure from the supply system or regulator causes volume variation. May be caused by regulator drift, supply depletion, or pneumatic leaks.

causes.name: Parameter Issue
causes.description: Dispensing parameters (time, pressure setpoint, speed, gap height) are incorrectly configured for the current material and application.

causes.name: Equipment Condition
causes.description: Mechanical wear, misalignment, or calibration drift in the dispensing equipment causes inconsistent performance.

causes.name: Valve Issue
causes.description: Dispensing valve malfunction, wear, or improper seating causes material leakage, dripping, or inconsistent shot volumes.

causes.name: Temperature Issue
causes.description: Ambient or material temperature outside acceptable range affects viscosity and curing behaviour, leading to spreading or inconsistent deposits.

causes.name: Substrate Condition
causes.description: Substrate surface energy, contamination, or moisture affects wetting behaviour and causes dispensed material to spread or bead irregularly.

causes.name: Nozzle Condition
causes.description: Nozzle tip damage, wear, or contamination at the tip face alters the dispensing pattern geometry.
